reconcileDrift: The current ScreenModel exposes only flat display items and RootActionRouter submits primary operations without required arguments. Production data commands validate typed fields, so editors, toggles, conflict choices, backup document IDs and lifecycle actions are visually present but cannot produce valid ScreenCommand arguments from user input.
goal: Define and test typed, locale-neutral interactive screen state for all sixteen screens so production Compose can render real values and issue valid argument-bearing ScreenCommands while MVIKotlin/Decompose retain drafts, validation and async state.
acceptanceCriteria: ScreenSnapshot/ScreenModel expose typed draft fields, option choices, read-only facts and action descriptors using stable keys/IDs and authored user data only; no localized app copy is embedded.
ScreenAction supports field edits and explicit submit/action intents; Store owns draft/validation/busy/error state and builds argument-bearing ScreenCommand values deterministically.
Every registered production operation declares its required arguments and subject semantics so invalid empty command submission is impossible from the typed contract.
Drafts survive expected Decompose state retention, destructive execution still uses ConfirmationRequested/ExecuteConfirmed exactly once, and cancellation never mutates data.
Preview components provide representative typed content/error/empty/permission/conflict/restore-preview states without production dependencies.

Contract tests cover all sixteen screens, all registry operations, validation/resource keys and state retention; no data, root, Compose, platform, build, ledger or external project changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
